title: Ryn Crim
features:
I asked chatgpt and he told me that my script had these functions, and honestly... I don't feel like writing it myself.
This script is a comprehensive utility hub for Criminality, designed to consolidate combat, world exploration, and visual synchronization into a single optimized framework. The core of the project is the World ESP system, which features deep-scanning logic to accurately highlight interactable objects such as Mystery Boxes, cash registers, safes, ATMs, and vending machines. Unlike standard ESPs, this system includes a dynamic validation layer that monitors the health and broken state of loot containers, ensuring that highlights are automatically removed the moment an object is looted or destroyed to prevent screen clutter. Additionally, it features a master synchronization clock that powers a unified Rainbow and Pulse effect across all active highlights, including NPC Dealers and dropped items, allowing all visual elements to cycle colors and transparency levels in perfect unison. By integrating these world-sensing features with the existing Aimbot, FOV, and Ghost tracking tabs, the hub provides a seamless interface that balances high-performance utility with a clean, synchronized visual aesthetic, all managed through a centralized configuration to avoid variable conflicts and ensure stability during high-intensity gameplay.
